rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCPJungle is a self-hosted MCP tool registry and proxy server built in Go that enables enterprise AI agents to discover, manage, and securely access multiple MCP servers through a centralized gateway. The implementation features dual operating modes (development for individual users, production for enterprises with authentication), supports both stdio and streamable HTTP MCP server transports, and provides a comprehensive CLI for server registration, tool management, and invocation with support for text, image, and audio content types. Built with PostgreSQL/SQLite storage, Docker deployment options, and fine-grained access control through client authentication and server allow-lists, it serves organizations needing centralized MCP tool governance, developers managing multiple MCP servers locally, and teams requiring secure multi-tenant access to distributed MCP resources with audit trails and permission management.
